description: This Java source file defines a RESTful API resource class for managing accounting rules within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting accounting rules, as well as for fetching template data for UI forms. The class interacts with various services to fetch account, office, and code value data, and handles serialization and security concerns.

classes.name: AccountingRuleApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing accounting rules, including endpoints for CRUD operations and fetching templates. Uses JAX-RS annotations and integrates with various platform services.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for creating or editing accounting rules, including allowed accounts, offices, and tag options.

methods.name: retrieveAllAccountingRules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all accounting rules visible to the authenticated user, with optional associations based on request parameters.

methods.name: retreiveAccountingRule
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific accounting rule by its ID, with optional response styling based on the request.

methods.name: createAccountingRule
methods.description: Creates a new accounting rule based on the provided request data, serializing it to JSON before issuing the command.

methods.name: updateAccountingRule
methods.description: Updates an existing accounting rule identified by ID with the provided data.

methods.name: deleteAccountingRule
methods.description: Deletes the accounting rule specified by ID.

methods.name: handleTemplate
methods.description: Helper method that constructs and returns template data, populating allowed accounts, offices, and tags.

methods.name: retrieveSelectedTags
methods.description: Helper method that filters and maps selected tags out of allowed tag options based on existing tag data.
